title: henry-cho-notes-to-self-2026-03-04
content:
Quick morning brain dump - 2026-03-04

Top priorities
- prod regression: investigate spike in tail latency for 8k seqs (slo breaches 03:10-04:00). Check recent kernel changes + batcher logs.
- land PR for KV-cache fix (runtime PR #214) -> need final perf run on prod-like (p3dn) before merge.
- follow up with infra on capacity for Dedicated alpha (SLA notes) \u2014 get capacity numbers for EU-west.

TODO (today)
- [ ] run nightly perf suite locally against quantized 4-bit model (seq len 4096) -- note: disable cross-attn micro-optim for that run.
- [ ] review and comment on Maya's notes about rollout policy for fallback models (confluence: CONFLUENCE-9876).
- [ ] sync with Ethan about autoscale incident postmortem draft.
- [ ] close JIRA-1423 (KV cache TTL incorrect) \u2014 add repro steps and attach logs.
- [ ] ping CS about customer X request for Private deployment demo next Tue.

Quick reminders / errands
- dentist appt 2026-03-06 10:30am (Dr. Lee) \u2014 schedule blocked on calendar.
- submit expense for GPU credits (Feb conference) by Friday.
- groceries: eggs, almond milk, spinach, coffee pods.

Notes to self (random)
- batching: try lowering max_batch_size to 32 for interactive routes \u2014 saw 20% latency tail reduction in sandbox but increased cost. Run cost calc.
- quantization profile: for that customer workload, prefer per-channel for first matmul only; mixed-int8 gave weird NGEMM perf on a100. Document behavior in notes.
- fallback policy: prefer model-size fallback over region fallback for latency-sensitive routes; fallback-by-cost only for non-urgent background jobs.

Meeting prep (1pm with platform-engineering)
- agenda: Dedicated capacity forecasting, autoscale knobs, and rollout windows.
- bring: current capacity usage dashboard screenshot, headroom projections, list of customers with SLA requests.

Scratch / one-off snippets
- quick curl to reproduce tokenization issue: curl -X POST $HOST/v1/encode -d '{\"input\":\"...\"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
- log grep: grep -i \"kv_cache\" /var/log/runtime/*.log | tail -n 200

Questions / followups
- ask Maya whether we want to keep the canary threshold at 5% or bump to 10% for bursty workloads.
- decide whether to include model-variant mapping in rollout config or keep it external (impacts UI complexity).

End notes
- If I get blocked on perf runs, prioritize writing up repro + timeline so SRE can triage.
- Keep this doc as scratch; transfer checklist items to Asana/Linear before EOD.

-- Henry
